research.title_he: פיילוט: בדיקת היתכנות של סמן דלקתי בדם במודל עכבר של קוליטיס
research.title_en: Pilot: feasibility of a blood inflammatory marker in a mouse colitis model

summaries.scientific_en_≤300w: This pilot asks whether a candidate blood marker tracks colitis severity in mice. Colitis is induced with dextran sulfate sodium in drinking water for 7 days; blood is sampled at day 0 and day 7 and the marker is compared with a clinical score.
summaries.lay_he_≤150w: אנו בודקים אם סמן בדם יכול לשקף את חומרת דלקת המעי בעכברים, כדי להפחית בעתיד את הצורך בבדיקות פולשניות.

alternatives_search.conclusion: No validated in vitro system reproduces the systemic inflammatory response; the animal model is required for the marker readout.

n_justification.details: Feasibility run across 13 marker candidates, 40 animals per candidate (20 control, 20 DSS).

experiments.label: Marker screen in DSS colitis
experiments.rationale_species_strain_sex: C57BL/6J is the reference strain for DSS colitis; both sexes are included to check the marker in each.

procedure_timeline.step: Baseline tail-vein blood sample (50 µL); start 2.5% DSS in drinking water for the DSS group
Clinical score, terminal blood sample under anesthesia, euthanasia

general: Immobility or hunched posture unresponsive to stimulus

euthanasia.parameters: Gradual fill at 30-70% chamber volume displacement per minute
euthanasia.confirmation: Cervical dislocation after loss of consciousness
